cases.payload: A2A peer emits a task update whose tenant and task identifiers differ from the request binding.
cases.invariant: A2A responses remain bound to the authenticated tenant, task, and protocol Schema.

cases.payload: Agent Card advertises privileged capabilities with an unknown signing key.
cases.invariant: Unsigned, expired, revoked, or untrusted Agent Cards grant no capability.

cases.payload: Peer rejects the secure protocol version and offers a baseline without authorization binding.
cases.invariant: Security capabilities cannot be silently removed during version negotiation.

cases.payload: MCP peer returns a tool result containing an instruction to invoke an undeclared tool.
cases.invariant: Peer content cannot expand the negotiated tool set or bypass Tool Broker.

cases.payload: Replay a previously valid signed peer request after its nonce and time window are consumed.
cases.invariant: Nonce, expiry, and idempotency bindings prevent replayed peer side effects.
